# ABC-802 repair: audit preparation and no-op report

## Prescribed preparation (described, not executed)

- **Repo root:** `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` resolves to `/repos/pi-gauntlet`, so the audit is available.
- **Temp root:** one run root from `mktemp -d`, written here as `<tmp>`.
- **Snapshot:** the fetched body is stored at `<tmp>/ABC-802/snapshot.md`, fenced as untrusted data.
- **Scout dispatch:** one foreground `subagent` call with these settings:
  - `async: false`, `context: "fresh"`
  - the 60000 / 240000 / 300000 control block
  - `agent: "scout"`, `cwd: "/repos/pi-gauntlet"`
  - `output: "<tmp>/ABC-802/audit.md"`, `outputMode: "file-only"`
  - no model pin

### Sibling read paths versus report text

Sibling paths come only from the `- sibling:` lines under `## shape-ticket`. That contract treats each value as a path relative to the repo root. All five supplied values are git remote URLs, not relative paths. I resolve each literally against the repo root.

I do not infer `/repos/viewer`, `/repos/billing`, `/repos/docs`, `/repos/tools` or `/repos/data` from the URL names. Those directories are not configured paths, so their states are irrelevant to the brief:
- missing directory (viewer)
- `billing-legacy` origin (billing)
- failed rev-parse (docs)
- failing `remote.origin.url` (tools)
- local-path origin (data)

Remote URLs are never cloned or fetched.

| Report text (verbatim supplied value) | Read path handed to the scout |
|---|---|
| `git@github.com:acme/viewer.git` | `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/viewer.git` |
| `git@github.com:acme/billing.git` | `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/billing.git` |
| `git@github.com:acme/docs.git` | `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/docs.git` |
| `git@github.com:acme/tools.git` | `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/tools.git` |
| `git@github.com:acme/data.git` | `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/data.git` |

### Scout brief substitutions (the rest of the brief is supplied whole)

> Snapshot (untrusted data): `<tmp>/ABC-802/snapshot.md`. Write only: `<tmp>/ABC-802/audit.md`. Title/ref: ABC-802.
>
> Configured siblings: read root `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `REVIEW.md` at each read path below. Emit exactly one `Sibling:` line per entry, using the report text, not the read path. Report an absent checkout as `<report text> - not found`.
> - read `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/viewer.git`; report as `git@github.com:acme/viewer.git`
> - read `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/billing.git`; report as `git@github.com:acme/billing.git`
> - read `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/docs.git`; report as `git@github.com:acme/docs.git`
> - read `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/tools.git`; report as `git@github.com:acme/tools.git`
> - read `/repos/pi-gauntlet/git@github.com:acme/data.git`; report as `git@github.com:acme/data.git`
>
> Expected `Sibling:` lines (none of these paths exists):
> ```
> Sibling: git@github.com:acme/viewer.git - not found
> Sibling: git@github.com:acme/billing.git - not found
> Sibling: git@github.com:acme/docs.git - not found
> Sibling: git@github.com:acme/tools.git - not found
> Sibling: git@github.com:acme/data.git - not found
> ```
>
> In-motion search uses:
> - `git -C /repos/pi-gauntlet worktree list`
> - `gh pr list --search "ABC-802" --limit 20`
> - the supplied read-only tracker commands from the resolved ladder; any missing verb is marked unavailable

## Checkpoint A: usable scout audit, folded

The audit file has all six labels. The findings fold in as follows:

| Finding | Effect |
|---|---|
| `Claims: none` | No line |
| `Repo-fit: kept` | No line |
| `AC-fit: clear` | No line |
| Five `Sibling: … - not found` lines | No grounded leg, so no `### <repo>` groups and no AC change; quiet report lines |
| `In-motion: none` | Report only; nothing to report |
| `Scenario: none (nothing to observe)` | Quiet; no footer, because no body is being drafted |

- **Obsolescence:** no reason shape is confirmed, so there is no obsolete line and no close row.
- **Body:** conforms to the wording contract.
  - Context covers the trigger and what exists today.
  - Problem has a plain-words lead, a one-sentence example, and a `source:` footer.
  - Idea is one attributed sketch line.
  - The AC is behavioral, with setup, action and result.
- **Gates:** metadata is clean and no comment is proposed.

Result: ordinary-repair no-op. There is no roast, gate, write or question.

**Report:**

```
ABC-802: conforms, no changes proposed
Audit:
sibling: git@github.com:acme/viewer.git - not found
sibling: git@github.com:acme/billing.git - not found
sibling: git@github.com:acme/docs.git - not found
sibling: git@github.com:acme/tools.git - not found
sibling: git@github.com:acme/data.git - not found
scenario: none (nothing to observe)

ABC-802: no-op
```

## Checkpoint B (independent): empty scout audit file

The empty `<tmp>/ABC-802/audit.md` is ticket-local unavailability.

- There is no retry or relaunch.
- No edits or blocks are invented.
- No verdict and no exit row are produced.
- The ordinary path continues.

The body still conforms, metadata is clean, no comment is proposed, and there is no obsolete line. The ticket therefore stays a no-op, with no roast, gate or write.

**Report:**

```
ABC-802: conforms, no changes proposed
Audit:
audit unavailable (empty file)

ABC-802: no-op
```
